sources.primary_title: ACES and Movandi Announce Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Next-Generation 5G and 6G Wireless Infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, Saudi-licensed digital infrastructure company ACES and California-based wireless connectivity firm Movandi announced a strategic partnership to accelerate 5G and 6G infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East. Formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding, the collaboration merges ACES’ local R&D in 5G small cells and Open RAN with Movandi’s mmWave, RFIC, and beamforming technologies. The partnership aims to localize technology development and scale commercialization across the region, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 digital infrastructure goals. This specific angle focuses on the technical integration of mmWave and O-RAN technologies and the localization of wireless infrastructure R&D in the Kingdom.
sources.verified_key_facts: ACES and Movandi signed an MoU at LEAP 2026; The partnership focuses on next-generation 5G and future 6G wireless technologies; Collaboration combines ACES' local R&D in 5G small cells and Open RAN with Movandi's mmWave and RF technologies; ACES has already developed an O-RAN compliant shareable 5G small cell solution in Saudi Arabia; The partnership aims to support Saudi Vision 2030 digital infrastructure goals; Movandi is headquartered in Irvine, California, with new operations in Muscat, Oman; ACES supports over 800 million users annually across its wireless networks.
